exposure: Information-Motivation-Behavioural skills (IMB) model combined with routine nursing
cohort: The study included 102 pregnant women who underwent Caesarean section in Hangzhou Women's Hospital, randomly divided into a Control group and an Observation group.
finding: Interventions based on the IMB model significantly lowered SAS, SDS, FSS, and EPDS scores, increased GSES scores, and reduced complication rates in caesarean section women compared to routine nursing alone.
